I've finished the searches and checked the official links, so here's the shortlist.

# Material for the next 3 episodes: 11 REAL FIX ideas

The searches found plenty of real problems with free official fixes. They found almost nothing on the competitor pages.

- **Series:** every idea below is **REAL FIX · PART N**, because the bible has retired MUM ASKS and AI RUNS MY SHOP. Mum's texts can still appear inside a REAL FIX.
- **Part numbers:** I've left them blank. They're still unsettled (079 says 8 but only parts 1 to 3 aired).
- **Links:** the fix links are the usual government websites, but I couldn't load the pages myself. The "free" claims come from news and explainer sites. Open each link before rendering.

## Ideas (★ = my pick for the next three)

1. **★ Family money. "Papa's pension stops in 14 days."**
   - **Problem:** pensioners must submit a life certificate by 30 Nov or the pension is held from December.
   - **Fix:** Jeevan Pramaan face check on an Android phone with the Aadhaar Face RD and Jeevan Pramaan apps. It's reported free on your own phone; doorstep service through India Post Payments Bank is about Rs 70.
   - **Links:** [jeevanpramaan.gov.in](https://jeevanpramaan.gov.in). Problem: [NewKerala, 8 Nov](https://www.newkerala.com/news/a/pensioners-must-submit-jeevan-pramaan-nov-end-avoid-disruption-408.htm), [PIB campaign summary](https://www.indianpaycalculator.in/govt-news/digital-life-certificate-campaign-5-2000-cities-november-2026).
   - **Comedy:** Gigi: "Done! I also shared Papa's Aadhaar with the family group." Byte: "Papa is not in the file."
   - Keyword idea: PENSION.

2. **★ Phone. "3 SIMs in my name. I own 1."**
   - **Fix:** Sanchar Saathi's "Know Mobile Connections" shows every number on your ID and lets you mark one as "not mine". Chakshu in the same app reports scam calls and texts.
   - **Links:** [sancharsaathi.gov.in](https://sancharsaathi.gov.in). Problem: Delhi police found a [network of mule bank accounts](https://newsable.asianetnews.com/india/delhi-police-arrests-three-in-rs-71-lakh-digital-arrest-fraud-case-articleshow-tqfn5vd) on 15–16 Nov, and the government reports [39 lakh mobiles disconnected](https://www.angelone.in/news/economy/chakshu-under-sanchar-saathi-reports-fraud-39-43-lakh-mobiles-disconnected-over-1-000-crore-loss-prevented).
   - **Comedy:** Byte: "Deleted all three." (including hers).

3. **★ Work. "Boss texted at 11:47 pm."**
   - **Why:** 060 was our best post since the reset.
   - **Fix:** a phone feature, not a law. Use Focus on iPhone or Bedtime / Do Not Disturb on Android, with the boss off the allowed list, plus one calm next-morning reply. India has no right-to-disconnect law; it's [only a pending bill](https://vidhilegalpolicy.in/blog/right-to-disconnect-in-india/).
   - **Problem source:** [88% of Indian employees contacted after hours](https://www.staffingindustry.com/news/global-daily-news/most-indian-employers-support-right-to-disconnect). It's an older Indeed survey, so check the date.
   - **Comedy:** Sage writes a five-paragraph reply to "ok?"

4. **Family money. "Rs 1 came in. Then a call."**
   - **Problem:** a small deposit arrives, then a caller pushes you to "return" a bigger amount. SBI warned about this in October.
   - **Fix:** check the bank app yourself and never pay back through a link or a caller. Also, NPCI has [stopped person-to-person UPI requests since 1 Oct 2025](https://www.businesstoday.in/personal-finance/banking/story/npci-to-tighten-upi-rules-peer-to-peer-collect-feature-to-end-in-october-489244-2025-08-13), so a "request" from a stranger is a red flag. Merchant requests still exist.
   - **Report:** [cybercrime.gov.in](https://cybercrime.gov.in) / 1930. Problem: [SBI warning](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/sbi-warns-of-upi-refund-scam-involving-small-deposits/tldr).
   - It sits close to 066 (the PIN), so give it a different angle.

5. **Family money. "Mum on a video call with 'CBI' for 6 hours."**
   - **Fix:** one rule. No police force or agency arrests anyone on a video call. Hang up and call 1930.
   - **Links:** [cybercrime.gov.in](https://cybercrime.gov.in). Problem: [Delhi Rs 71 lakh case, 15–16 Nov](https://www.thehansindia.com/news/cities/new-delhi/woman-loses-rs-71-lakh-to-digital-arrest-three-arrested-1142634). Don't use the victim's details.
   - **Comedy:** Sage over-apologises to the fake officer.

6. **Bills. "Power cut tonight at 9:30, says SMS."**
   - **Fix:** the electricity board never asks you to call a personal mobile number or install a "bill update" app. Check on your board's own website or the number printed on your bill, then report the SMS on Chakshu.
   - **Problem source:** [SBI warning](https://inshorts.com/en/news/sbi-warns-against-electricity-bill-scam-involving-fake-kyc-calls-1794762287052) and a [Jalandhar senior who lost Rs 1.2 lakh](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/jalandhar/sr-citizen-loses-rs-1-2l-in-electricity-bill-scam-427428).

7. **Phone / something you own. "Rs 500 challan. Pay in 24 hours."**
   - **Fix:** type in [echallan.parivahan.gov.in](https://echallan.parivahan.gov.in) yourself and check with your vehicle number. Never install an APK file sent by SMS.
   - **Problem source:** [PIB warning](https://www.business-standard.com/india-news/fake-traffic-challan-scam-pib-warning-whatsapp-sms-links-126071000400_1.html). It's from July, not the last two weeks.

8. **Exams. "JEE form closes in 6 days."**
   - **Dates:** the regular deadline is 22 Nov and the late window (Rs 500 extra) runs to 26 Nov.
   - **Fix:** apply only on [jeemain.nta.nic.in](https://jeemain.nta.nic.in) and download the confirmation page. The fee itself is not free, but the fix is.
   - **Problem source:** [Shiksha](https://www.shiksha.com/news/engineering-nta-jee-main-2027-registration-live-session-1-form-last-date-blogId-246496). A good one for parents of students.

9. **Work. "Average hike 9%. I got 4%."**
   - **Fix:** a method. Write a one-page list of wins with numbers and ask in one clear sentence. Use the reported averages: [Aon 9.1%](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/top-headlines/average-pay-hike-across-sectors-projected-at-9-1-per-cent-in-2026-survey/), [IT services 6.9% (Deloitte)](https://www.deloitte.com/in/en/about/press-room/average-increment-in-india-is-expected-to-be-9-1-percent-in-2026.html).
   - **Risk:** 065 (appraisal) got 0.12x, so it would need a stronger loss in the hook.

10. **Jobs. "Rs 2,999 for the laptop. Then the job."**
    - **Fix:** find the job on the company's own careers page, and check the company on the government's free MCA company lookup (I couldn't open it to confirm the price). Report fakes on [cybercrime.gov.in](https://cybercrime.gov.in).
    - **Problem source:** [guide](https://blog.kindjobs.in/fake-job-offer-india/). Only generic guides turned up, no fresh news. Too close to 069 (joining fee) unless it's framed as the Telegram "task" version.

11. **Phone (hold until 27 Nov). "90% off. Ends in 10 minutes."**
    - **Problem:** fake Black Friday stores ([2,000+ found last year](https://www.digit.in/news/general/hunting-black-friday-deals-beware-2000-fake-amazon-and-apple-lookalike-sites-are-scamming-shoppers)).
    - **Fix:** type the shop's address yourself and look for misspelt names in the link.

**Suggested order:** 1 → 3 → 2. That's family money, then work, then phone, with no topic twice in a row. The pension deadline makes it the most urgent this week.

## AI habits to use (true to life)
- **Agreeing with everything:** a [Stanford study in *Science* (March 2026)](https://wtop.com/lifestyle/2026/03/ai-is-giving-bad-advice-to-flatter-its-users-says-new-study-on-dangers-of-overly-agreeable-chatbots/) found chatbots backed the user's actions 49% more often than people did. Users also didn't notice and liked it more. This suits Sage taking the scammer's side, then Meera's side.
- From the bible: the essay for a one-line reply (idea 3), Gigi oversharing to the family group (idea 1), Byte taking "delete the extra ones" literally (idea 2).

## Dates in the next 10 days
- **20 Nov:** SAT registration closes (late to 24 Nov). ACET may close the same day, but sources disagree.
- **22 Nov:** JEE Main regular deadline (late to 26 Nov).
- **24 Nov:** Guru Nanak Jayanti, a holiday in many states (some lists say 23, 25 or 27).
- **25 Nov:** SNAP closes.
- **30 Nov:** pension life certificate deadline.
- **Just after:** Black Friday (27 Nov) and IIT placements phase 1 (1 Dec).

## Competitor pages
I found nothing on @ashutoshwithclaude or @canwebuildthis. Search doesn't index their reels or comments, and the results were mostly vendor blogs. To see this month's hooks and comment counts, someone needs to look in the Instagram app.
